label: Remedy edition
title: Cannabis Sativa
text:
Cannabis Sativa.

         Hemp. (Urticaccae)



Sensation as of   drops of water falling
        on or from single parts; on the head, form the anus, stomach, heart. Obstinate constipation,
        causing retention of the urine; constriction of anus. Contraction of fingers after a sprain.
        Dislocation of patelly on going up stairs. Dyspnoea or asthma, where the patient can only
        breathe   by standing up  . Choking in swallowing, things go
        down "the wrong way" (Anac.). Acute, inflammatory stage of gonorrhoea (second
        stages, burning after urination, discharge thick, yellow, pus-like, Cub.). Urethra very
        sensitive to touch or pressure; cannot walk with legs close together, it hurts the urethra.
        Pain extending from orifice of urethra backward, burning-biting, posteriorly more sticking,
        while urinating. Tearing pains along urethra in a zigzag direction.


  Relations  . - Similar: to, Canth.,
        Caps., Gels., Petros., in early stages of specific urethritis.



 Keynotes  by H.C. Allen
